metrics_hierarchy.canonical_accuracy: Evaluates only the initial static prompt (rotation_id=0). Subject to high variance from positional priors.
metrics_hierarchy.debiased_mean_accuracy: Mean accuracy across all permutations: (1 / R) * sum(Acc_r). Cancels out uniform slot biases.
metrics_hierarchy.strict_accuracy: Requires correct prediction across all permutations: product of indicator(pred_r == gold_r). The definitive measure of invariant semantic reasoning.

empirical_proof_of_necessity.vulnerability_of_canonical_metric: In Base Qwen, Canonical Accuracy is 6.25% because the gold answers in the stratified sample were distributed across options (b), (c), (d), while Base Qwen overwhelmingly guessed slot (a). Had the gold answers arbitrarily clustered in slot (a), Base Qwen's canonical accuracy would have been falsely measured at >80% despite possessing zero temporal reasoning ability.
empirical_proof_of_necessity.role_of_strict_metric: Strict Accuracy (all 4 rotations correct) filters out opportunistic slot hits. Base Qwen achieves only 6.25% strict accuracy, whereas Arm 5 achieves 12.5% strict accuracy (+100% relative improvement), proving genuine invariance to presentation order.
empirical_proof_of_necessity.role_of_debiased_mean: Debiased Mean Accuracy (Base: 20.31%, Arm 5: 34.38%) provides an unbiased expected accuracy across the permutation space, establishing a reliable +14.07% performance advantage for Arm 5.

governance_rule: Under ADR-114 and Documenting RULE, scientific claims of temporal reasoning gain must be grounded in Debiased Mean and Strict Accuracy across full rotation sets. Single-slot canonical accuracy is retained strictly for historical regression auditing.

verdict.summary: Cyclical rotation debiasing is indispensable for generative evaluation, cleanly disentangling true factual temporal association from pre-training slot selection heuristics.
